title: 第4章 残酷的事实第5章 俎上之肉
slug: 剑里乾坤第3107章不似作伪
content_zh:
第二天天还没亮，外面的鞭炮声就炸个不停，高天宇早早的就穿好衣服，先过来给父母拜了一个年，然后他对父母说道“爹！娘！我现在就骑马过去看看大帅府是什么情况，你们在家安心等我消息！”高老爷也想过去看看，让高天宇阻止了！毕竟老爷子年纪大了！外面又是冰天雪地的！
高天宇骑着马就向大帅府方向去了！一路上只见到处都是白茫茫的一片，路上连一个人也没有，快到午时他来到了大帅府，他被眼前的一切惊呆了，他都不相信自己的眼睛，眼前一片残垣断壁，昔日富丽堂皇的大帅府，如今已经成了一堆废墟，现场还有几个身穿官衣的衙役，正把废墟里面的尸体一具一具的抬出来，空地上已经摆了大约三十多具尸体，高天宇看着眼前的一切，他真的不相信自己的眼睛，他不敢相信，也不愿意相信，但是事实告诉他，这些都是现实！都已经发生了！赫赫有名的大帅府在年三十晚上，被人一夜之间全部杀了，被人一把火烧了！高天宇怔怔的伫立在那里，久久没有动，整个人僵在那里了！他眼泪不由自主的流了下来，过了好久他才平复下来，他迈步走向那几个衙役，那些衙役见张名扬走过来，连忙喝止住他说道“你是干什么的？”高天宇满眼泪水的说道“卓正刚是我姐夫，请问一下这是什么情况？”那为首的衙役走过来说道“哦！原来是卓大帅的小舅子啊！我们来了以后就是这样的，什么情况你都看见了，目前为止我们和你知道的一样多，你明天去知府衙门一趟，我们先把现场处理一下！”说完冲高天宇一抱拳，转身去那堆残垣断壁中继续搜寻尸体去了！高天宇慢慢的走到那些些尸体旁边，他还抱着侥幸心理，希望自己的姐夫不在这里，他一个一个的揭开蒙在那些尸体上的白布，这些尸体有的还能辨认出来，有的已经被大火烧的面目全非了！就在他揭开第九具尸体蒙在脸上的白布的时候，他的手僵硬了，他最不愿意看见，也最不愿意接受的事实摆在那里了！那熟悉的面庞出现在他的眼里，他看着卓天刚睁着的眼睛，他知道卓天刚这是死不瞑目，他轻轻的把白布又盖了上去，强忍住内心的悲痛，他现在要回去，要把这事情告诉自己父母！
他翻身上马，飞快向家里奔去，他不知道怎么和自己的爹娘说，但是又不能不说，到家以后，两位老人正在房间里面焦急的等待，高天宇到了门口犹豫了一下，但是最终还是走进了房间！进到房间以后，高天宇把自己所见的一切，从头到尾的和两位老人说了一遍，两位老人虽然已经有了心理准备，但是真的听到这个消息以后，他们还是失声痛哭，尤其是老太太，更是哭的如同一个泪人一般，高天宇连忙把她扶到卧室，他转身来到父亲身边说道“爹！明天我去知府衙门一趟，处理一下后事。您看这事还要告诉姐姐吗？”高老爷想了一下说道“宇儿！你姐夫常年征战，对外阻击外敌入侵，对内剿匪安民，也杀了不少人，恨你姐夫的人太多了，想杀你姐夫的人也不少，根据你描述的情景，这些人心狠手辣，他们应该是故意选择在年三十晚上动手，因为正常来说这个时候正是全家团圆的时间，他们这是要斩草除根，不留后患啊！然儿可是你姐夫唯一的血脉，千万不能再出差错了！你姐姐不让她过来见卓正刚最后一面，于情于理都说不过去，但是我怕她看了正刚的死状会受不了，我更担心她们的安全！所以不通知她们了，你去处理吧！多带些银票，把你姐夫风风光光的下葬！”高天宇点了点头说道“爹！听你的，我明天就去办！”听到房间里面传来母亲的抽泣声！高天宇无可奈何的摇了摇头，离开了房间！
他出来以后，喊管家过来说道“你从厨房里面把吃的东西分点出来，然后找一个可靠的人送到乡下老宅去，让去的人什么也不要说，把东西送到就可以了！”原来高天宇心里想着：大年初一没有地方可以买东西，尤其是乡下地方，更是这样，所以他才会安排人送点吃的过去！管家连忙点头说道“少爷！我这就去安排！”说完他转身就离开了。高天宇回到自己房间，他坐在椅子上，回想着今天自己所看见的一切，回想着姐夫死不瞑目的样子！他心如刀绞，姐夫和姐姐他们是从小一起长大的，姐夫的父亲和自己的父亲是好兄弟！从小就为他们定下了这门婚事，只不过后来两位老人的发展方向不一样了，一个从商了，另外一个则从军了！但是两家一直有来往，一直就像一家人一般！高天宇小时候就喜欢跟在卓正刚屁股后面，也可以说卓正刚是看着高天宇长大的！高天宇一直很崇拜自己的姐夫，他本来也想从军跟随自己的姐夫，可是他最终只能被自己老爷子硬逼着，不得不去接手自家那些生意！想到姐夫卓然凭借自己过人的胆识，卓着的战功，一步一步走到大帅这个位置！他守护着北疆百姓的幸福，没想到现在就天人两隔了！
高天宇倒了一杯水，他已经一天没吃任何东西了，他感觉不到饿，他喝了一口水以后，思考着姐姐和卓然今后应该怎么办？因为卓正刚的父母五年前因病双双去世了，唯一的遗憾就是没看见他们两人生个孩子！而现在的姐姐和外甥，可以说已经没有家了！他也感觉父亲说的很对，当前形式还不明确，首先要保护好姐姐和外甥，然后再看看是什么情况再做决定！究竟是谁胆子这样大？居然敢在年三十的晚上把大帅府灭门了！毕竟自己姐夫是朝廷的封疆大吏，掌管着数十万大军的兵马大元帅啊！
content_en:
Before dawn the next day, the sound of firecrackers outside kept going off. Gao Tianyu got dressed early and came over to pay his parents a New Year's greeting. Then he said to his parents, "Dad! Mother! I'm going to ride over now to see what's going on in the Marshal's Mansion. You guys can wait for my news at home!" Mr. Gao also wanted to go over and have a look, but Gao Tianyu stopped him! After all, the old man is old! It’s icy and snowy outside again!
Gao Tianyu rode towards the Marshal's Mansion! All he saw along the way was a vast expanse of white, and there was no one on the road. It was almost noon when he arrived at the Marshal's Mansion. He was stunned by everything in front of him. He didn't believe his eyes. There were ruins in front of him. The former magnificent Marshal's Mansion was now a pile of ruins. There were also Several government officials in official uniforms were carrying out the corpses from the ruins one by one. There were already about thirty corpses placed in the open space. Gao Tianyu looked at everything in front of him. He really didn't believe his eyes. He didn't dare to believe it, and he didn't want to believe it, but the facts told him that these were realities! It's all happened! On the night of New Year's Eve, the famous Marshal's Mansion was all killed overnight and burned down! Gao Tianyu stood there in a daze, not moving for a long time, completely frozen there! His tears flowed down involuntarily, and it took him a long time to calm down. He walked towards the government officials. Seeing Zhang Mingyang approaching, the government officials quickly stopped him and said, "What do you do?" Gao Tianyu said with tears in his eyes, "Zhuo Zhenggang is my brother-in-law, what is going on?" The leader of the government officials came over and said. He said, "Oh! It turns out he is Marshal Zhuo's brother-in-law! This has been like this since we came here. You have seen everything. So far we know as much as you do. You go to the prefect's Yamen tomorrow and we will deal with the scene first!" After saying that, he gave Gao Tianyu a fist and turned to continue searching for corpses among the ruins! Gao Tianyu slowly walked to the corpses. He was still taking chances and hoped that his brother-in-law was not here. He removed the white cloth covering the corpses one by one. Some of these corpses could still be identified, and some had been burned beyond recognition by the fire! Just when he uncovered the white cloth covering the face of the ninth corpse, his hands stiffened. The fact he least wanted to see and least want to accept was right there! The familiar face appeared in his eyes. He looked at Zhuo Tiangang's open eyes. He knew that Zhuo Tiangang was determined to die with his eyes open. He gently covered the white cloth again, suppressing the grief in his heart. He wanted to go back now and tell his parents about this!
He got on his horse and ran towards home quickly. He didn't know what to tell his parents, but he had to say that after arriving home, the two old men were waiting anxiously in the room. Gao Tianyu hesitated when he arrived at the door, but finally walked into the room! After entering the room, Gao Tianyu told the two old people everything he saw from beginning to end. Although the two old people were mentally prepared, they still burst into tears after hearing the news, especially the old lady, who cried like a tearful person. Gao Tianyu quickly helped her to the bedroom. He turned around and came to his father and said, "Dad! I will go to the prefect's Yamen tomorrow to deal with the funeral arrangements. You have to tell your sister about this." "Is that so?" Mr. Gao thought for a moment and said, "Yu'er! Your brother-in-law has been fighting all year round, resisting foreign invasions and suppressing bandits at home. He has also killed many people. There are too many people who hate your brother-in-law, and there are also many people who want to kill your brother-in-law. According to your description, The situation described above shows that these people are cruel and ruthless. They must have deliberately chosen to take action on the night of New Year's Eve, because normally this is the time for family reunions. They want to eliminate the root cause without leaving any further troubles. Ran'er is your sister!My husband’s only bloodline must not make any mistakes again! Your sister's refusal to let her come over to see Zhuo Zhenggang for the last time is unjustifiable both emotionally and rationally. But I'm afraid she won't be able to bear it after seeing Zhenggang's death. I'm even more worried about their safety! So I won’t notify them, just go and deal with it! Bring more banknotes and bury your brother-in-law in glory! Gao Tianyu nodded and said, "Dad!" Listen to you, I will do it tomorrow! "Hearing his mother's sobs coming from the room! Gao Tianyu shook his head helplessly and left the room!
After he came out, he called the housekeeper over and said, "Put out the food from the kitchen, and then find a reliable person to deliver it to the old house in the country. Ask the person who goes there not to say anything, just deliver the food!" "It turns out that Gao Tianyu was thinking: There is no place to buy things on New Year's Day, especially in the countryside, so he arranged for someone to send some food there! The housekeeper nodded quickly and said, "Master! I'll make arrangements right away! "After that, he turned around and left. Gao Tianyu returned to his room. He sat on a chair, thinking about everything he had seen today, and thinking about his brother-in-law's death with a look on his face! He was heartbroken. His brother-in-law and his sister grew up together, and his father and his father were good brothers! This marriage was planned for them since they were young. However, the development directions of the two old men were different later. One went into business and the other joined the army! But the two families have always been in contact and have always been like a family. He is an ordinary person! Gao Tianyu liked to follow Zhuo Zhenggang when he was a child. It can be said that Zhuo Zhenggang grew up watching Gao Tianyu! Gao Tianyu always admired his brother-in-law. He originally wanted to join the army and follow his brother-in-law, but in the end he could only be controlled by him. The old man was forced to take over his own business! Thinking that his brother-in-law Zhuo Ran had reached the position of commander step by step with his extraordinary courage and outstanding military exploits! He was guarding the happiness of the people in Northern Xinjiang. I didn't expect that now we are separated from each other!
Gao Tianyu poured a glass of water. He hadn't eaten anything for a day. He didn't feel hungry. After taking a sip of water, he thought about what his sister and Zhuo Ran should do in the future. Because Zhuo Zhenggang's parents both passed away due to illness five years ago, my only regret is that I didn't see the two of them have a child! But now my sister and nephew can be said to have no home! He also feels that what his father said is right. The current situation is not clear yet. First, he must protect his sister and nephew, and then see what the situation is before making a decision! Who is so brave? How dare you destroy the Marshal's Mansion on the night of New Year's Eve! After all, his brother-in-law is a high official of the imperial court, a military marshal in charge of hundreds of thousands of troops!
